in_sanskrit.meaning: Thief in the heart of all beings, remover of sorrows, and the cause of the creation, preservation, and destruction of the universe (Hari) + bravery (Beer)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Harbeer is derived from the Sanskrit words 'हरि' (Hari) and 'वीर' (Beer). Hari is a popular Hindu deity, also known as Vishnu, who is considered the protector and sustainer of the universe. He is the remover of sorrows and the cause of creation, preservation, and destruction. The name Beer means 'bravery.' Thus, Harbeer can be interpreted as a name that signifies the one who is brave and protects the universe like Hari.
